item.text: {"analysis":"The 64-negative trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5737, up 0.0100 from the reported parent score of 0.5637. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.625, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.595, Electronics 0.375, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.700. Electronics improved from the reported 0.345 to 0.375. This supports increased negative coverage in this run, but does not establish repeatability or identify which expert drove the fusion improvement. Allocated GPU time was 469.19 seconds; expert-specific scores and update throughput were not supplied.","code_summary":"Preserves four separately trained category ensembles, each combining a causal SASRec with a gated cumulative-history preference representation and a MultVAE. SASRec samples 64 uniform negatives with replacement per active position, excluding the user's complete training history, and trains with 65-way cross-entropy. MultVAE training remains unchanged. Expert rankings use equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60. Preserves seeds, deadlines, checkpoint selection, dataset routing, and generated predictor architecture; adds isolated sampler/loss/gradient checks, update timing logs, and checkpoint/predictor agreement checks."}
